mechanism: Chlorthalidone can increase rosuvastatin levels by reducing renal clearance and may potentiate statin-induced myopathy risk through metabolic effects; thiazide diuretics also increase glucose and lipid levels, potentially reducing statin efficacy.
action: Monitor for signs of myopathy (muscle pain, weakness); consider renal function monitoring and assess lipid control; the combination is generally acceptable but requires clinical vigilance.
